items.summary_zh: Web 管理介面緩衝區溢位，可遠端攻擊。
items.fix_hint: 廠商尚未回應，建議限制管理介面存取。
items.desc_en: A vulnerability has been found in Comfast CF-N1-S 2.6.0.1. Impacted is the function get_css_path_from_uri of the file /cgi-bin/mbox-config of the component Web Management Interface. The manipulation leads to stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

items.summary_zh: 驗證處理程式溢位，可遠端執行攻擊。
items.fix_hint: 建議更新韌體或更換已停止支援的設備。
items.desc_en: A vulnerability was determined in D-Link DIR-868L 2.01b05. This issue affects the function strcpy of the file /webfa_authentication.cgi of the component Authentication Handler. Executing a manipulation of the argument id/password can lead to stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized.

items.summary_zh: 診斷端點指令注入，可遠端執行代碼。
items.fix_hint: 廠商未回應，建議關閉診斷功能或限制存取。
items.desc_en: A vulnerability was determined in Netcore NBR200V2 1.3.241127.071246. This affects an unknown part of the file /www/cgi-bin/network_tools of the component CGI Diagnostic Endpoint. This manipulation of the argument param/key/val causes command injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.summary_zh: 網路診斷功能指令注入，可遠端執行。
items.fix_hint: 廠商未回應，建議停用 Traceroute 診斷功能。
items.desc_en: A vulnerability has been found in Netcore NBR200V2 1.3.241127.071246. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file /usr/bin/network_tools of the component Traceroute Diagnostic Feature. The manipulation of the argument url leads to command injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.summary_zh: LAN IP 配置功能指令注入，可遠端執行。
items.fix_hint: 廠商未回應，建議加強內部網路存取控制。
items.desc_en: A vulnerability was found in Netcore NBR200V2 1.3.241127.071246. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file /usr/bin/network_tools of the component LAN IP Configuration Handler. The manipulation of the argument ipv4 results in command injection. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
